rule: game-lines desk probability + passing desk verdict + DraftKings price, pre-game only
note: No pre-game alerts: an alert needs a game-lines-desk probability whose verdict passed (not NO EDGE / UNPROVEN) and a DraftKings price. NBA: 3 desk verdict NO EDGE; NHL: 6 not pre-game; WNBA: 1 not pre-game; MLS: 8 not pre-game; EPL: 4 not pre-game; UCL: 9 not pre-game; NFL: 14 desk verdict UNPROVEN; NCAAF: 11 started or no start time; NCAAB: 1 not pre-game; CWS: 1 not pre-game
